description: Excel (.xlsx) reader and writer — pure LOOK, no native code and no external service. Reads and writes genuine Office Open XML workbooks: writes stored ZIPs (CRC32), and reads both stored and DEFLATE-compressed files (carries its own RFC-1951 inflate), so it round-trips its own output and opens spreadsheets made by Excel/Sheets/LibreOffice. Multiple sheets, real number cells, UTF-8/Turkish. Verified against openpyxl.
author: codlook
